svg.text: ROACH / NFC WRITER
Control interlock, commissioning and source references
Target schematic only. The handoff document and connection tables are authoritative companions to these sheets.
REV A0 | ENGINEERING TARGET | NOT FOR FABRICATION | 04 NOV 2026
SHEET 6 OF 6
Concept target only. Not a complete netlist. Direct and PA links are mutually exclusive. See START_HERE.md before KiCad implementation.
HARDWARE CONTROL REQUIREMENTS
ANT_VALID = exactly one of ANT_REQ0 through ANT_REQ4.
Relay requests must be masked off while RF drive is active.
RF enable requires RF_PERMIT, ANT_VALID, settled relays and no fault.
PA enable additionally requires PA path selected and PA request.
Default pulldowns: requests, RF permit and PA enable.
Coil drivers: low side MOSFETs with gate pulldown and flyback clamp.
Hardware RF kill needs supply gating and I/O isolation; see handoff.
Implement actual logic and fault latch before schematic release.
Observe real coil release time. Do not switch contacts with RF on.
FIRMWARE SEQUENCE
Disable PA and reader RF, then wait for field decay.
Release old relay. Select new path and wait for settling.
Start at low drive, poll and identify one target label.
Hold the selected path through upload and display refresh.
Check protocol response then verify the visible image by camera.
Turn off RF before retrying another antenna or changing paths.
Save per antenna drive settings, cable identity and tuning results.
Abort on fault, multiple targets or uncertain refresh state.
COMMISSIONING ORDER
1 Verify U101 power and SPI. Confirm tag identity and the real label command protocol.
2 Bring up one direct matched panel at low drive. Complete a known image refresh with camera verification.
3 Add the selector. Measure every path and all inactive antenna interactions in the metal cavity.
4 Engineer and validate the optional PA including RX feedback. Establish an approved operating envelope.
5 Map full update success across product positions and orientations. Confirm product dwell time and thermal behavior.
PRIMARY REFERENCES
ST DS13541 Rev 11: st.com/resource/en/datasheet/st25r3916b.pdf (pin map, supplies, RF limits)
ST AN5592 Rev 1: st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5592-st25r-single-ended-antenna-matching-stmicroelectronics.pdf
ST AN5276: antenna design for ST25R3916 / 3916B family. Use ST matching tools and measured coil data.
NXP AN13219: nxp.com/docs/en/application-note/AN13219.pdf (metal environment and antenna matching)
Balto docs/hardware-paths.md and docs/eink-protocol.md: PN532 remains unconfirmed.
Label manual: Santek EZ Sign supplied PDF. Exact tag IC and air protocol remain unconfirmed.
